title: Ueber die Geschichte des Ammoniaksodaprozesses
version: Volume 258, printed p. 335, based on Ludwig Mond’s 1885 historical report
lineage: A German contemporary trade-journal account reporting Thom’s letters and industry testimony, not the original 1836 letters. It characterizes the work as an early technically imperfect manufacturing attempt.

passages.note: Printed pp. 335–336: Thom at Turnbull and Ramsay in Camlochie in 1836, Newton in 1840, and later commercial difficulties
